title: Integrated Adversarial Independent-Evidence Qualification
adversarial_requirements: Reassess AETHER-221 custodian enrollment and AETHER-222 supplied original-byte/challenge checks independently
Bind source, holder and issuer root/operator/administrator ancestry across enrollment and capture records
Bind exact enrollment ID, nonce and holder signing-key fingerprint across both protocols
Preserve nonce replay and substituted receipt/capture byte diagnostics
Require explicit native execution gate and evidence-manifest results with matching claimed source revision
Forbid native or manifest authority promotion, even when documentary evidence is otherwise consistent
Treat self-reported CI PASS and declared independent custodian status as unverified without external provenance
No automatic history selection, lock reclamation, repair, recovery or physical ACT
unresolved_evidence: No externally retrieved and independently authenticated custodian key and control ancestry
No independently authenticated original hardware capture or device signature verification
No externally authoritative nonce ledger, trusted clock or independent host challenge exchange
No independently confirmed native CI run, compiler result, artifact origin or physical qualification
A locally constructed matching bundle remains one owned ancestry unless independently corroborated
